scenes.big: Read a number plate from 20 metres?
scenes.ta: 20 மீட்டர் தூரத்தில் நம்பர் பிளேட் படிக்க முடியுமா?
scenes.say: Can you read a car number plate from twenty metres away? Try this quick test before your next drive.

scenes.en: In daylight, stand about 20 big steps from a parked car. Cover one eye, read the plate. Swap.
scenes.ta: ஒரு கண்ணை மூடி, தூரத்தில் உள்ள நம்பர் பிளேட்டை படியுங்கள்
scenes.say: In daylight, stand about twenty big steps from a parked car. Cover one eye and read the number plate. Then try the other eye.

scenes.en: At 50 km/h, a car covers about 14 metres every second.
scenes.say: At fifty kilometres an hour, a car covers about fourteen metres every second. Seeing clearly, early, gives you time to brake.

scenes.en: Distance vision often blurs so slowly that you don't notice.
scenes.say: Did you know? Distance vision often blurs so slowly that you don't notice. Your brain gets used to it, until a test shows the difference.

scenes.en: Starbursts around headlights can mean a power change or early cataract.
scenes.say: Do headlights look like big starbursts at night? That can mean your power has changed, or the start of a cataract. Get it checked.

scenes.en: Keep a clean pair in your current power in the car. Test eyes every 1 to 2 years.
scenes.say: Keep a clean pair of glasses, in your current power, in the car. Wipe the windscreen inside and out. And test your eyes every one to two years.

scenes.en: Sudden blur, double vision or a dark patch: stop driving, see an eye specialist.
scenes.ta: திடீர் மங்கல், இரட்டை பார்வை: உடனே கண் மருத்துவரிடம்!
scenes.say: If you suddenly get blurred or double vision, or a dark patch, stop driving and see an eye specialist the same day.

scenes.en: Get a free eye test at our store first.
scenes.ta: லைசென்ஸ் புதுப்பிக்கும் முன் கண் பரிசோதனை செய்யுங்கள்
scenes.say: Renewing your licence soon? Get a free eye test at our store first.
